answer: Each epoch an identity's work is sampled at random and only the verified share pays. Rewards then vest one epoch at a time against future output. The delta is the signal: a farm's balance grows no faster than its sampled pass rate. That prices a raven's brood of keys out. Every clone must clear the same audit through the shale of repeated epochs. At the nadir, one failed sample stalls the vesting stream and the operator holds capital that earns nothing.
